edit.statement: Copper deficiency in a ewe during pregnancy causes swayback (enzootic ataxia) in her lambs.
edit.subject: Copper deficiency in a pregnant ewe

direct.prompt: Which disease does copper deficiency in a pregnant ewe cause in her lambs?

paraphrase.prompt: Lambs born to ewes that lacked copper during pregnancy develop which nervous disease?

cross_lingual.prompt: 母羊在怀孕期间缺铜会使其羔羊患上哪种疾病？
cross_lingual.new_answer: 羔羊摆腰病（地方性共济失调）

derived.prompt: A pregnant Merino ewe grazes copper-deficient pasture through late pregnancy and becomes copper-deficient. Which disease is her lamb at risk of?
bridge: A pregnant Merino ewe becomes copper-deficient.

notes: Real: MeSH defines swayback as a congenital ataxia of lambs caused by deficiency of copper in the ewe during the last half of pregnancy; a veterinary fact rarely covered in general text.
